text:
maria: FYI urgent hotfix for runtime that regresses KV cache memory path on embed-worker -> OOMs during bursts in prod-eu-central1. Planning a quick revert + canary. Need expedited approvals.
kevin: Do we have a tiny diff? how intrusive is the revert?
maria: Tiny: flip quant_path flag and rebuild image (redwood/embed:revert-v2.1.4). No schema or DB changes.
sam: Can we stage a smoke test plan and rollback commands before we push?
maria: Smoke: 1000 synthetic requests seq len 1024, check 500s/ooms, mem usage. Rollback plan: pin to redwood/embed:v2.1.3 and scale back. Rollback commands:
```
kubectl set image deploy/embed embed=redwood/embed:v2.1.3 -n prod-eu-central1
kubectl rollout status deploy/embed -n prod-eu-central1 --watch
```
deploy-bot: deploybot: created release job rls_1739995000 by maria 1 expedited approvals required: eng-lead, oncall, infra. Starting staging canary in 3m.
oncall-ops: I'm oncall, will run smoke and check logs. ping me when staging done.
len: Infra quick review: ok as long as healthchecks are enabled and no config drift. I approve.
kevin: Product approves - customer impact rising, go ahead. :ship: 
Maria: staging canary started. tagging logs. threshold: >0.2% 500s or OOM logs -> halt.
sre-bot: monitor: staging embed-worker mem usage stable. 0 errors so far.
oncall-ops: staging smoke: passed 1k requests, no OOMs. Approve rollout to prod-eu-central1 5% canary.
deploy-bot: deploybot: approvals received (maria, len, kevin, oncall-ops). Promoting canary to prod-eu-central1 5% traffic.
maria: watching metrics. Set auto-stop if 500-rate > 0.3% or p95 latency +25%.
sre-bot: alert: prod-eu-central1 embed-worker OOM logs detected on 2 pods at +5m, 500-rate jump to 0.45%. Circuit-breaker engaged, halting rollout.
kevin: saw the alert. Recommend immediate rollback and notify customer ops.
maria: rolling back now to pinned image per plan. Executing rollback commands.
deploy-bot: deploybot: executing rollback rls_1739995000 1 pinning to redwood/embed:v2.1.3, scaling new pods down, traffic shifted back to safe image.
oncall-ops: Confirming post-rollback: 500-rate back to baseline within 90s. No DB impact.
len: Good catch. We'll need to gate the quant_path change behind an additional perf test for high-seq loads.
sam: I'll open a short postmortem and include timeline + canary thresholds + action items (+ add test to perf harness).
maria: Thanks team 1 expedited approvals helped contain user impact. Filing follow-up RFC to improve canary automation. :thumbsup:
